ValidationRule.description: A handler record applies to one context on one object, so exactly one context field is filled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(ISBLANK(BeforeInsert__c), 0, 1) + IF(ISBLANK(AfterInsert__c), 0, 1) + IF(ISBLANK(BeforeUpdate__c), 0, 1) + IF(ISBLANK(AfterUpdate__c), 0, 1) + IF(ISBLANK(BeforeDelete__c), 0, 1) + IF(ISBLANK(AfterDelete__c), 0, 1) + IF(ISBLANK(AfterUndelete__c), 0, 1) <> 1
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select the trigger object in exactly one context. For a class that runs in several contexts, create one record per context.
